## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Ads pressure.**
      2 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Jul 30, 2026 - Aug 1, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _egor484848_, Aug 1, 2026, 2/5: "The user experience without payment is far from being friendly. Yes, your app is user-friendly in terms of UX/UI compared to other trackers. But, seriously, by adding subscription ads after every product addition, you're just killing the desire to buy a subscription. It feels like the subscription is only needed to bypass the artificial hurdles you've created yourselves, and paying just for a tidy interface in 2026 doesn't seem appealing at all. I'll look for something with a less aggressive marketing strategy."
            2. _Kete_GER_, Jul 30, 2026, 3/5: "The ads in not-pro version are absolutely annoying so if your looking for sth free, it’s not your choice. Pro version is still good but I wanted to track only protein so there are better options, Yazio is in this case too expensive."
            3. _0SAH1991_, Jul 30, 2026, 4/5: "The app is great I love it! But I a few remarks first I’m noticing some bugs I redownloaded the app and it seems to have fixed some of them but not all. My evening and Saturday chests don’t work still and I still have to close out the app every time I record my food because I get the ads and it goes white and won’t go back to the main page. Also i wish I could turn off fasting there doesn’t seem to be a way to do that. I would like there to be a way to celebrate or encourage friends maybe sending stickers to the friends when they reach a milestone like Met a water , weight or step goal or send like little reminders to help support each other in using the app. But other than that I love it!"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 10, 2026 - Jul 31, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Dyakonova_, Jul 31, 2026, 1/5: "Very disappointed with both the app and its customer support. I paid for this app and used it every single day on the same phone, spending hours logging my meals. I even have Screen Time reports proving my daily usage. After losing my streak due to what appears to be a technical issue, I contacted support with evidence, but they refused to restore it or offer any compensation. On top of that, the photo analysis is often inaccurate. In my experience, it frequently miscalculates calories and other nutritional values, so I often have to correct them manually. It’s frustrating to pay for an app, invest so much time in it, and then receive no real help when something goes wrong. If keeping your streak matters to you, be aware that support may not help you if you encounter a technical issue."
            2. _blumenkaft_, Jul 1, 2026, 1/5: "At one time this was an efficient tracker, but now it’s bloated and frustrating. They could have prioritized improving database accuracy, purging duplicate entries, or barcode reliability, but I guess that’s actual work. Instead we have a broken app where they change the icon every month and add time-wasting gamification elements that don’t even work! Lol, every day I earn a chest of ‘diamonds’ that can’t even be collected."
            3. _AB_LV_, May 10, 2026, 1/5: "Keeps crashing and I can’t connect the step counter with my garmin connect app, paid for premium membership so very disappointed"
<!--/ir-theme-->
